title: Review map: full application design and portable coding context
summary: Expandable two-layer map with canonical internals, 67 branches, all 29 exact agreement sections and current memory rules. A review map, not a claim of finished semantic-record migration.
body: Open project-memory/maps/two-layer-map.html. Data is project-memory/maps/two-layer-plan.json; regenerate with scripts/build_two_layer_map.py. The complete preserved agreement is included and mapped to branches. Canonical schema inventory distinguishes existing typed YAML from missing fine-grained context routes. Original model locks and one-page restrictions are shown as historical. User requested both layers together, including every canonical subcomponent, on 2026-09-25. Browser navigation and no horizontal overflow were checked at desktop and narrow widths. Source preservation does not independently certify interpretation of every summary.
change_reason: Save complete two-layer review map requested by Lohith; preserve exact plan text
